help:
Field Flow Python
field-flow [--lang en-US|zh-CN] --help
初始化新合成库：field-flow state init --synthetic --mode dry_run|execute --state-dir NEW --instance-id ID
只读查看：field-flow state inspect --state-dir PATH
运行：field-flow run --config FILE --state-dir PATH [--execute]
fixture_help: Python合成夹具：python -m tests.fixtures --config FILE --evidence-dir NEW；用SIGINT/SIGTERM正常退出
